title: Vaguely Optimized
description: A Modpack Which Boosts Your Performance, Makes Minecraft More Visually Pleasing and Adds more Client-Side and QoL changes!
body:
This is a modpack which consists of a number of mods which

- Improve your game's performance
- Makes Minecraft more visually appealing
- Adds QoL changes like a map or moving when your inventory is open
